description: This is an HTML file that serves as the front-end interface for a database visualizer application. It contains structure, styles, and JavaScript code to display and interact with database listings, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the backend API and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by calling loadDatabases and resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables, and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database from the backend API and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an HTML table with the data fetched from the backend.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell content, with special handling for objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses long cell content or object data for readability.
